recordingMaximumHelp: Heidrun Code stops recording at this duration and transcribes the audio already captured.
recordingWarningHelp: The push-to-talk button starts flashing red after this much time. Set this time below the maximum recording duration.
modelDownloaded: The model is on this computer.
modelMissing: The model is not on this computer.
downloadFailed: The download failed. Check the network.
auditCopyFailed: Could not copy the audit prompt.
auditHelp: Paste the prompt into Codex or Claude Code. Find the Filters heading at the end. Replace “All” with your own value, or keep “All” or delete the filter line to leave it unrestricted. The audit applies both filters together.
auditWordsHelp: Enter the words you meant to say, separated by commas. If Voice Input wrote “coma se parate d’liste,” enter “comma-separated list.”
auditConversationsHelp: Describe which conversations to review. Include the source, topic, or date range, for example “Codex cloud conversations about Heidrun Notebook from the last two weeks.”
auditPrompt:
Help me improve the Heidrun Code Voice Input word replacement list. Use Heidrun Data to inspect my saved conversations within the filters below. Use surrounding messages and my explicit corrections to determine what I meant to say. When I specify intended words or phrases, look for recurring incorrect transcriptions of those words or phrases, including different incorrect renderings of the same phrase.

Read the current word replacement list through the Heidrun Code controller (`heidrun_code_ctrl voice_words`). Leave out duplicate proposals and replacements already covered by the current list. Avoid proposing changes that would replace valid phrases. Show me a table with one row per proposed replacement and columns for the incorrect transcription, the intended replacement, and examples from the conversations that support the proposal. Flag ambiguous cases and gaps in the conversations you could inspect.

Ask me to approve the proposed replacements and wait for my explicit approval. After I approve, use the Heidrun Code controller to add only the replacements I approved. Read the list back to verify the changes and summarise what was added.

Replace “All” with your own values to narrow the audit. Keep “All” or delete a filter line to leave that filter unrestricted. Include any date range in the Conversations filter.

Under Intended words, enter the words as you meant them. For example, if Voice Input wrote “coma se parate d’liste” when you said “comma-separated list”, enter “comma-separated list.” The audit looks for the different ways Voice Input transcribed those words.

## Filters

- Intended words: All
- Conversations: All
